limits: Owner test count is retained evidence, not a test run performed by this reviewer.
The time budget limits ledger scheduling and queries; mandatory source/file reads can add wall time.
Any actual observation or consumer integration requires separate evidence; this review does not claim the producer bug is repaired.

review_findings.finding: Original producer summary and heartbeat future clocks could age into diagnostic acceptance while later files were read.
review_findings.resolution: Each original generated clock is checked against its own retained byte-read completion. Forecast joins also retain read clocks and reject original issue/publication/consumption above original join completion.

review_scope: Read-only source review; no independent test rerun, actual ledger read, process action, forecast fit, routing or runtime write.
verified_boundaries: SQLite mode=ro plus query_only and deny-mutation authorizer, pinned per-ledger transaction and bounded queries/record length.
Exact original registry, activation, contract, original source closure and separately bound observer sources.
Frozen publication validation plus original decision/attempt/reference quote identity and original clocks; no numerical refit or source-input replay claim.
Original native H1 expiry refreshed at aggregate completion; missing or unvisited ledgers remain unavailable; current input readiness is explicitly unobserved.
Original producer envelopes are diagnostic only and never authorize forecast acceptance. New observer schema/spec and immutable summary bytes preserve original forecast identity.
